datasets.title: Daily station weather
datasets.description: Global Historical Climatology Network daily summaries: temperature, precipitation, snow, and other elements from land surface stations, served by the NCEI Access Data Service with station and date filtering.
datasets.selection: Station observations within inclusive calendar dates; selected elements
datasets.inputs: Both dates; station IDs or a geographic query

datasets.title: Monthly station climate
datasets.description: Monthly station summaries derived from GHCN-Daily (means, extremes, totals) via the NCEI Access Data Service dataset global-summary-of-the-month. Selects whole calendar months and explicit stations, or discovers stations through the companion search service.
datasets.selection: Complete UTC calendar months touched by the query; station and element filters
datasets.inputs: Both dates; station IDs or a geographic query

datasets.title: Annual station climate
datasets.description: Annual station summaries derived from GHCN-Daily via the NCEI Access Data Service dataset global-summary-of-the-year. Selects complete UTC calendar years and explicit stations, or discovers stations through the search service.
datasets.selection: Complete UTC calendar years touched by the query; station and element filters
datasets.inputs: Both dates; station IDs or a geographic query

datasets.title: Hourly airport observations
datasets.description: Hourly, special, synoptic, and daily-summary reports from airport and first-order stations via the NCEI Access Data Service dataset local-climatological-data, addressed by eleven-digit station ids and timestamped in local standard time. Select whole days, stations or a location, and optional columns.
datasets.selection: Every report on whole calendar days per station; optional column filters
datasets.inputs: Both dates; eleven-digit station IDs or a geographic query

datasets.title: Storm Events details
datasets.description: NCEI's significant-weather event details since 1950, with locations, impacts, and narratives. Anonymous whole-year gzipped CSV archives; select the latest creation-date revision for each requested year. No server-side row, location, or variable subsetting. Historical event coverage and reporting practices vary; fatalities and locations tables are separate products not included by this adapter.
datasets.selection: Whole annual archives; filter rows locally after downloading

datasets.title: SPC tornado database
datasets.description: The Storm Prediction Center's tornado database since 1950 as plain CSV: one row per tornado or state/county segment with date, local time, EF or F rating, injuries, fatalities, loss, start and end coordinates, path length and width, and FIPS codes. Whole files linked from the SPC page: annual from 2008, half-decade for 2000-2007, decade for 1950-1999. Stable names revised in place; no server-side row, location, or variable subsetting.
datasets.selection: Whole annual, half-decade, or decade files; filter rows locally after downloading
datasets.inputs: Both dates (selects the files covering those years)

datasets.title: NEXRAD radar scans
datasets.description: Raw volume scans from the WSR-88D weather radar network, archived in the public unidata-nexrad-level2 S3 bucket (NOAA Open Data Dissemination). One object per radar site per volume scan. No server-side subsetting; whole files are fetched. Select radars by site id, bbox, or nearest to a point.
datasets.selection: Whole radar scans by site and inclusive UTC scan-start time
datasets.inputs: Both timestamps; radar IDs or a geographic query

datasets.title: MRMS gridded radar products
datasets.description: Gridded CONUS products merged from every radar plus other sensors: rotation tracks, reflectivity, hail size, echo tops, precipitation rate, and lightning probability as two-minute gzipped GRIB2 files in the public noaa-mrms-pds S3 bucket laid out as CONUS/PRODUCT/YYYYMMDD/. Select one product from the supported list and a file-stamp window of at most one day; each asset is a complete CONUS grid with no spatial subsetting.
datasets.selection: Whole two-minute CONUS grids of one product by inclusive UTC file stamp, at most one day

datasets.title: NEXRAD derived radar products
datasets.description: Derived single-radar products (super-resolution reflectivity and velocity, dual-polarization moments, mesocyclone and storm-track detections, echo tops, accumulations) in the public unidata-nexrad-level3 S3 bucket, with flat keys SITE_PRODUCT_YYYY_MM_DD_HH_MM_SS where the site id drops the first letter of its ICAO id. One object per product per volume scan since 2020-03-30; earlier products are archived at NCEI. Files are fetched whole and have no reader.
datasets.selection: Whole product files by site, product code, and inclusive UTC scan time since 2020-03-30
datasets.inputs: Both timestamps; product codes; radar IDs or a geographic query

datasets.title: GOES CONUS imagery
datasets.description: Single-channel CONUS Cloud and Moisture Imagery (ABI-L2-CMIPC) from GOES-16, 17, 18, and 19 in anonymous NOAA S3 buckets. Select an explicit satellite, channel, and scan-start interval; each asset is a complete NetCDF scene with no geographic or variable subsetting.
datasets.selection: Whole single-channel CONUS scenes by inclusive UTC scan-start time

datasets.title: GOES lightning detections
datasets.description: Lightning flash, group, and event detections (GLM-L2-LCFA) from GOES-16, 17, 18, and 19 in anonymous NOAA S3 buckets. Select an explicit satellite and a file-start interval of at most one day; each asset is a complete 20-second NetCDF detection table with no geographic subsetting.
datasets.selection: Whole 20-second detection files by inclusive UTC file-start time, at most one day

datasets.title: Tropical cyclone best tracks
datasets.description: National Hurricane Center best-track database: six-hourly position, intensity, pressure, and wind radii for Atlantic (since 1851) and northeast/north-central Pacific (since 1949) tropical cyclones. One fixed-format text file per basin, revised after each season; a basin parameter picks the file and the newest revision wins. There is no query interface, so dates and geographic filters are rejected and the local reader turns the whole file into one row per track point.
datasets.selection: The newest revision of one whole basin file; filter track points locally
datasets.inputs: Optional basin (atlantic or pacific); no dates or geographic filters

datasets.title: HRRR model output
datasets.description: High-Resolution Rapid Refresh 3 km CONUS forecasts in GRIB2 from the anonymous noaa-hrrr-bdp-pds S3 bucket, one whole file per run and forecast hour. Select a run by initialization window and cycle hour, the forecast hours, and the surface, pressure-level, or native file variant. Files are 150 MB to 750 MB; fields are selected after download with the GRIB2 reader, not by the server.
datasets.selection: Whole CONUS files by run initialization window, cycle hour, forecast hours, and file variant, at most one day

datasets.title: 30-year station climate normals
datasets.description: Daily, monthly, and annual/seasonal 30-year station normals via the NCEI Access Data Service datasets normals-daily-1991-2020, normals-monthly-1991-2020, and normals-annualseasonal-1991-2020, chosen with a period parameter. Dates are optional; daily and monthly normals accept a month-day window inside a placeholder year. Explicit stations or station discovery through the companion search service.
datasets.selection: Monthly, daily, or annual/seasonal normals per station; optional month-day window for daily and monthly
datasets.inputs: Station IDs or a geographic query; dates optional

datasets.title: Coastal water levels
datasets.description: Preliminary or verified six-minute observed water levels from the anonymous CO-OPS Data API. Select one station, an explicit vertical datum, units, and a UTC interval of at most 28 days. Raw CSV retains quality flags; predictions and station discovery are not included.
datasets.selection: Six-minute observations for one station and datum; at most 28 days
datasets.inputs: Station, datum, and both minute-aligned timestamps

datasets.title: Coastal tide predictions
datasets.description: Astronomical tide predictions from the anonymous CO-OPS Data API for one station, an explicit vertical datum, and units, on a six-minute, other minute, hourly, or high/low interval spanning at most a year. Subtracting predictions from observed water levels isolates the non-tidal residual, such as storm surge.
datasets.selection: Predictions for one station and datum on a chosen interval; at most a year
datasets.inputs: Station, datum, and both minute-aligned timestamps; optional interval

datasets.title: Sea-surface temperature
datasets.description: NOAA geo-polar blended daily SST analysis (day and night) on a global 5 km grid, ERDDAP dataset noaacwBLENDEDsstDNDaily on the CoastWatch server, with server-side spatial, temporal, and variable subsetting. Raw CSV subsets retain grid coordinates and units without volatile NetCDF history.
datasets.selection: Grid centers and timestamps inside the requested bounds; optional stride
datasets.inputs: BBox or location, and both timestamps

datasets.title: GHCN-Hourly Station Observations
datasets.description: Global hourly and sub-hourly surface observations, the successor to ISD. Published as per-station and per-year bulk files by NCEI; the exact access path has not been confirmed yet and must be verified before an adapter is built.

datasets.title: IBTrACS Global Tropical Cyclone Tracks
datasets.description: International Best Track Archive for Climate Stewardship: merged best tracks from all agencies worldwide since 1842. CSV and NetCDF files by basin or period from an NCEI HTTPS directory (v04r01).

datasets.title: GFS Forecast Model Output
datasets.description: Global Forecast System output in GRIB2 from the public noaa-gfs-bdp-pds S3 bucket, laid out as gfs.YYYYMMDD/HH/atmos/ with files per resolution and forecast hour (for example pgrb2.0p25.fNNN).

datasets.title: National Blend of Models
datasets.description: Statistically blended forecast guidance in GRIB2 from the public noaa-nbm-grib2-pds S3 bucket, laid out as blend.YYYYMMDD/HH/core/ with files per region and forecast hour.

datasets.title: nClimDiv Climate Divisional Data
datasets.description: Monthly temperature, precipitation, and drought indices for U.S. climate divisions, states, and regions since 1895, as fixed-width text files in an NCEI monitoring-content directory refreshed monthly.

datasets.title: Sea Ice Index
datasets.description: Daily and monthly Arctic and Antarctic sea ice extent and concentration (NOAA@NSIDC G02135) as CSV, GeoTIFF, and shapefiles in an HTTPS directory hosted by NSIDC.

datasets.title: ERSST Monthly Sea Surface Temperature
datasets.description: Extended Reconstructed SST v5: monthly global 2 degree analysis since 1854, one NetCDF per month in an NCEI HTTPS directory.

datasets.title: OISST Daily Sea Surface Temperature
datasets.description: Optimum Interpolation SST v2.1: daily global 0.25 degree analysis since September 1981 as one NetCDF per day, from the NOAA CDR S3 bucket (data/v2.1/avhrr/YYYYMM/) or the NCEI HTTPS mirror.

datasets.title: Ocean Carbon and Acidification Data System
datasets.description: Archived ocean carbon, pH, and related chemistry datasets (cruises, moorings, syntheses such as SOCAT and GLODAP) in an NCEI HTTPS directory organized by accession.

datasets.title: ETOPO 2022 Global Relief
datasets.description: Global topography and bathymetry at 15, 30, and 60 arc-seconds as NetCDF and GeoTIFF tiles, served through the NCEI THREDDS catalog with OPeNDAP access; the THREDDS pattern.

datasets.title: Global Historical Tsunami Database
datasets.description: Tsunami source events and runup observations since 2100 BCE from NCEI, served as JSON by the HazEL hazard-service API with year, magnitude, and location filters.

datasets.title: World Data Service for Paleoclimatology
datasets.description: Proxy climate records (tree rings, ice cores, sediments, corals) with a JSON study-search API from NCEI that returns study metadata and data file URLs filtered by data type, region, and time span.

datasets.title: SWPC Real-Time Space Weather Products
datasets.description: Planetary K index, solar wind, and other real-time indices as small JSON files from the Space Weather Prediction Center services host. Rolling recent windows only; historical archives live elsewhere.

datasets.title: NDVI Climate Data Record
datasets.description: Daily global normalized difference vegetation index from AVHRR and VIIRS since 1981, one NetCDF per day in the public noaa-cdr-ndvi-pds S3 bucket laid out as data/YYYY/.

datasets.title: Daily water observations
datasets.description: Daily statistics (streamflow, gage height, temperature) for USGS monitoring sites via the modern USGS Water Data OGC API. Anonymous, paginated CSV downloads filtered by site or bbox, dates, and parameter codes; daily mean by default, with units and quality metadata preserved.
datasets.selection: Site observations for inclusive local calendar dates; parameter and statistic filters
datasets.inputs: Both dates; site IDs or a geographic query

datasets.title: Earthquake Catalog (ComCat)
datasets.description: Global earthquake events with location, magnitude, and depth from the ANSS Comprehensive Catalog via the FDSN event web service. Anonymous REST with bbox, time, and magnitude filters.

datasets.title: 3DEP Elevation
datasets.description: Seamless digital elevation models from the 3D Elevation Program (1/3 arc-second and 1 m where available). Tiled rasters on public cloud storage; spatial selection by tile.

datasets.title: American Community Survey 5-Year Estimates
datasets.description: Population, housing, income, and demographic estimates for every geography down to block group, via the Census Data API. Anonymous for light use; an API key lifts rate limits.

datasets.title: Air Quality System Daily Summaries
datasets.description: Daily pollutant summaries (ozone, PM2.5, NO2, and others) from regulatory monitors via the AQS Data API. Requires a free API key issued by email.

datasets.title: National Flood Hazard Layer
datasets.description: Effective flood zones, base flood elevations, and related features from FEMA's flood insurance rate maps, available as county or state extracts and through ArcGIS services.

datasets.title: GPM IMERG Precipitation
datasets.description: Global half-hourly and daily merged satellite precipitation estimates. Discovered through NASA CMR and downloaded from GES DISC. Requires a free Earthdata Login; the first credentialed dataset.

datasets.title: Cropland Data Layer
datasets.description: Annual 30 m raster of crop type across the contiguous United States from NASS, served through CropScape with bbox extraction.
